description: An exhilarating 11-day adventure trip to New York City, featuring thrilling outdoor activities, scenic views, and cultural exploration. This itinerary balances high-energy experiences with opportunities to discover the city's unique charm.

days.title: Arrival and City Introduction
days.description: Arrive in New York, check into your hotel, and take some time to settle in before a relaxed evening exploring the immediate surroundings.

days.title: Central Park Bike Adventure
days.description: Start your adventure with a private bike tour through the iconic Central Park, followed by a leisurely afternoon.

activities.activity_name: New York Bike Tour — Private Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see the iconic landmarks and hidden gems of Central Park on two wheels. What to bring: Bring comfortable clothing, water, and a camera to capture the beautiful scenery. What to eat: Enjoy a casual lunch at a cafe near Central Park after your ride. Good to know: This private tour offers a personalized experience of the park.

days.title: Mountain Hike and Scenic Views
days.description: Embark on a challenging mountain hike to discover breathtaking viewpoints around New York.

activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see stunning natural landscapes and panoramic views of the New York area. What to bring: Wear sturdy hiking shoes, bring plenty of water, snacks, and sun protection. What to eat: Pack a picnic lunch to enjoy amidst the scenic beauty. Good to know: This is a full-day activity suitable for active travellers.

days.title: Zipline and Ropes Course Thrills
days.description: Experience an adrenaline rush with a zipline and ropes adventure, followed by a relaxed afternoon.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see challenging aerial courses and thrilling ziplines. What to bring: Wear comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes. What to eat: Grab a quick bite at a nearby cafe after your adventure. Good to know: This activity is perfect for adventure seekers looking for an exciting experience.

days.title: Kayaking the New York Coastline
days.description: Explore the New York coastline from a unique perspective with a kayaking tour.

activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see the New York skyline and coastline from the water. What to bring: Wear swimwear or quick-drying clothes, sunscreen, and a hat. What to eat: Enjoy fresh seafood at a waterfront restaurant after your tour. Good to know: This tour is suitable for active travellers and offers a unique perspective of the city.

days.title: Snorkelling Day Trip
days.description: Escape the city for a snorkelling day trip, discovering underwater wonders near New York.

activities.activity_name: Snorkelling Day Trip from New York
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see diverse marine life and clear waters on this day trip. What to bring: Bring your swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, and a change of clothes. What to eat: Lunch will likely be provided or available for purchase during the trip. Good to know: This activity is great for families and adventure seekers looking for a refreshing escape.

days.title: Countryside Exploration
days.description: Take a day trip to the New York countryside, enjoying a change of scenery and fresh air.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see picturesque landscapes, charming towns, and natural beauty outside the city. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes, a camera, and layers of clothing for changing weather. What to eat: Enjoy a meal at a local eatery in the countryside. Good to know: This full-day trip offers a relaxing break from the urban environment.

days.title: City Sightseeing and Culture
days.description: Explore the city's highlights with a hop-on hop-off bus pass and delve into its rich history with a walking tour.

activities.activity_name: New York Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Pass
activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see major landmarks and attractions across New York City at your own pace. What to bring: Bring your camera, comfortable shoes for getting on and off, and a map. What to eat: Enjoy diverse dining options as you explore different neighborhoods. Good to know: This pass offers flexibility to explore the city's sights.

activities.activity_name: Historic New York City Walking Tour
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see historic sites and learn about the rich past of New York City. What to bring: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring water. What to eat: Discover local eateries in the historic neighborhoods you visit. Good to know: This tour provides insightful commentary on the city's heritage.

days.title: Museums and Local Culture
days.description: Immerse yourself in New York's art and culture with a museum pass and a language crash course.

activities.activity_name: New York Museum & Gallery Pass — Small Group Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see a curated selection of art and historical exhibits in various museums and galleries. What to bring: Bring a small bag for personal items and comfortable shoes for walking. What to eat: Enjoy a light lunch at a museum cafe or a nearby restaurant. Good to know: This pass allows access to multiple cultural institutions.

activities.activity_name: New York Language & Culture Crash Course
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn basic phrases and cultural insights to enhance your New York experience. What to bring: Bring a notebook and pen if you wish to take notes. What to eat: Explore local snacks or coffee shops after your class. Good to know: This course is a fun way to connect with the local culture.

days.title: Leisure and Departure Preparation
days.description: Enjoy a final morning in New York at your leisure, perhaps revisiting a favorite spot or doing some last-minute souvenir shopping, before preparing for your evening departure.

days.title: Travel Day
days.description: Depart from New York, concluding your adventure.
